findings.title: Explain character runtime with stage, retry and slot-wait breakdowns
findings.details: Active stage ages hid completed work, archived failures and capacity waits. Add per-character queue clock time, full retained stage history, role totals, slot waits, failures and exact metadata/result links. Bound current attempts by queue timestamps and label historical/unknown durations.
findings.verification: 19 observer/server/timing tests passed; fresh desktop/mobile Playwright verified actual timing table, current/history filters, role bars, metadata HTTP 200 and clean console. Sample 车 showed about 40 min clock, 18 min model stages, 21 min slot waiting.
